categories.main_business_segments: Hubei Zhongyi Technology Inc. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance single and double-sided electrolytic copper foil products. Its main product lines include lithium battery copper foil and electronic circuit copper foil, which are essential materials for lithium-ion batteries, copper-clad laminates, and printed circuit boards. The company operates production bases in Yunmeng and Anlu and serves industries such as new energy vehicles, energy storage, consumer electronics, and telecommunications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes electrolytic copper foil manufacturing technology involving copper dissolution, electrolysis in sulfuric acid copper electrolyte, surface roughening, and anti-oxidation treatments. It has developed advanced production lines with features like high-efficiency copper dissolution, precise purification, stable foil formation, and flexible automated control. The company emphasizes ultra-thin copper foil production (down to 4.5μm), high tensile strength, and high elongation copper foil, supported by proprietary additives and equipment design. It also invests in R&D for new materials such as lithium-copper composite anodes and solid-state battery copper foils.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers of power lithium-ion batteries for new energy vehicles, energy storage batteries, and 3C digital products, as well as producers of copper-clad laminates and printed circuit boards used in communications, optoelectronics, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, and aerospace. The company has established stable partnerships with leading battery manufacturers and PCB producers, serving both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Hubei Province and sales distributed across major regions including East China, South China, Southwest China, Central China, Northwest China, Northeast China, and North China. It does not report significant overseas operations but serves customers domestically with a broad regional footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hubei Zhongyi Technology Inc. operates primarily in the upstream to midstream segments of the lithium-ion battery and electronics supply chains by producing key raw materials—high-performance electrolytic copper foils—that serve as essential components for battery manufacturers and PCB producers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in ultra-thin and high-strength copper foils, development of high-end electronic circuit copper foils for 5G/6G and AI applications, and new materials for solid-state batteries and composite copper foils. It invests heavily in R&D, collaborates with universities, and focuses on digitalization and intelligent manufacturing to improve product quality and production efficiency. The strategic plan includes expanding capacity, optimizing product mix towards high-value products, and enhancing green and low-carbon production processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of electrolytic copper foil products, priced based on a formula of copper material cost plus processing fees. The company operates a direct sales model, negotiating prices with customers based on product specifications and market conditions. It also earns income from government subsidies and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as one of the well-known high-performance electronic copper foil manufacturers in China, competing with firms such as Longdian Huaxin Group, Guangdong Jiayuan Technology, Jiujiang Defu Technology, Nord New Materials, and Anhui Tongguan Copper Foil Group. It holds a strong position in ultra-thin lithium battery copper foil segments and is advancing into high-end electronic circuit copper foil markets, aiming to capture import substitution opportunities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.79 billion, a 40.13% increase year-over-year, with copper foil sales volume growing 37.75% to about 60,987 tons. Despite revenue growth, net profit turned negative at approximately RMB -84.2 million due to intense market competition, lower processing fees, increased credit impairment provisions, and higher R&D and stock-based compensation expenses. Total assets reached RMB 6.36 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 3.51 billion. The company is in a growth phase with expanding capacity and product sales but faces profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced production technology, ability to produce ultra-thin (≤6μm) and high-strength copper foils with superior physical properties, and comprehensive product range covering lithium battery and electronic circuit copper foils. It highlights its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary additives, and flexible production lines that meet high-quality standards demanded by leading battery and electronics manufacturers. The firm positions itself as a reliable supplier supporting the energy transition and intelligent interconnection with products tailored for new energy vehicles, energy storage, AI, and 5G/6G applications.
